quarterly_data.quarter: Google blog: Meet Project Suncatcher, a research moonshot to scale (11-04-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Google announced Project Suncatcher, a research moonshot to one day scale machine learning in space with an interconnected network of solar-powered satellites equipped with Google's TPU AI chips; its preprint describes constellation design, control and communication and initial learnings from radiation testing Google TPUs.

players.product: two Project Suncatcher TPU prototype satellites for Google and Pelican satellites integrating NVIDIA IGX Thor on-orbit compute
